items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I made a recording with Don Murray

ctx.x: Because they could have made a mistake there in the machine or something. Well, yeah, yeah, that's right. Maybe they made a test record and they just felt with a cell or something. That's right. Maybe they'll get something else, the band knows. Yeah, they'll get something happened or... They'll tell any reason. They can tell them. Did you ever know Don Murray? Played tenor saxophone. Yeah, Don Murray, sure. I just wondered if he made any records, would you always like them?
Don Murray, that I can remember, I made a recording with Don Murray, but where?
You recorded with several guys out there, different bands? Yeah.
